subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway 40B Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board reopened the public hearing for a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit for a 350-unit residential development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway. The board established a schedule for thematic future meetings and authorized hiring peer review consultants for technical oversight.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Project Presentation
items.summary: The applicant, MVP Mystic LLC, presented a revised plan for a 350-unit, eight-story development consisting of two buildings with ground-floor retail and 25% affordable housing. The revision reduces the unit count by 30 from the original 2020 filing and adds green space and a public pocket park.

items.title: Staff Technical Requirements and Zoning Status
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte confirmed the project is subject to the zoning ordinance adopted in March 2022 and requested detailed technical diagrams, including code analysis and average grade plane calculations. The board and applicant discussed the potential use of Community Preservation Act (CPA) funds to further lower rents in affordable units.

items.title: Authorization of Peer Reviews
items.summary: Approved a motion to authorize city staff to hire peer review consultants for architectural design, stormwater and drainage, traffic and parking, and civil engineering.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule and Continuance
items.summary: Continued the hearing to January 9, 2023, while setting a schedule of seven thematic meetings through April 2023 to address technical areas and public comment. The chair deferred public comment to the January session once city staff and peer review responses are available.
